Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked

Everything you need to know before you take the leap.

Booking is simple — tell us your destination, date, and group size, and we'll arrange your ride instantly. Our team is available 24/7 to assist with any special requests or custom itineraries across Sri Lanka.
We offer flexible cancellation on most bookings. Standard bookings can be cancelled up to 48 hours before your trip for a full refund. Luxury and custom packages have a 7-day cancellation window. We also offer travel insurance add-ons for complete peace of mind.
Absolutely! Groups of 6 or more receive automatic discounts of 10–20% depending on the package. Corporate groups and destination weddings receive custom pricing. Contact our group travel specialists for a tailored quote.
Yes! We have a dedicated solo travel program with special pricing that eliminates single supplements. You can join small group tours (max 12 people) to meet like-minded explorers, or opt for a fully private custom journey designed just for you.
Our all-inclusive packages cover luxury accommodation, daily breakfast and selected meals, private airport transfers, guided tours and entrance fees, a dedicated personal travel concierge, and 24/7 emergency support. Flights can be added on request.
